reasoning: On the season so far the Rockets are the stronger team; with home court the Rockets start about 10 points better, in a game of about 227 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 3 points towards the Rockets.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Rockets win 82 times in 100, by about 13; most games like this end between 198 and 247 total points.

analyst.text: Philadelphia played their stars to clinch East Group B on Friday and are now resting them: Joel Embiid (plantar fasciitis management) and LeBron James (back) are out, along with Jaylen Brown (hamstring). Dean Wade is questionable. Houston's Steven Adams is questionable (knee). A depleted 76ers side on a back-to-back leans clearly Houston.
